name: HTTP GET Operation
description: Performs a simple HTTP GET request using the HTTPAdapter

url.description: The URL to make a GET request to

headers.description: Optional HTTP headers to include in the request. A User-Agent is sent when none is supplied — the venue's own, published at v/info/adapters/http — and an explicit one always wins.

queryParams.description: Optional query parameters to append to the URL

followRedirects.description: Follow 3xx redirects (default true). Every hop passes the same SSRF checks as the first URL, credentials are dropped on a change of origin, and the venue caps the chain (v/info/adapters/http maxRedirects); a loop or a longer chain fails the request. false returns the redirect response itself.

bearerSecret.description: Optional reference to a secret (e.g. 's/MY_TOKEN') resolved from the caller's secret store and sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'. For a plaintext bearer token, set the Authorization header directly via 'headers' instead.

secretHeaders.description: Optional map of HTTP header name to secret reference. Each resolved secret is used as the complete header value, so store values such as 'Basic <base64>' or the API key itself. Resolved headers override matching literal headers and this entire field is redacted from job records.

status.description: HTTP status code from the response

body.description: The response body from the HTTP request

url.description: The URL the response came from — the last of the chain when redirects were followed

redirects.description: The redirects followed, in order, each {status, from, to}; absent when there were none
